findings: THE MENU MADE THE SCOPE. Europe, Africa, Asia-Pacific, the Americas and the Middle East are the page's region selector, which leads to CMS's offices (read 2026-10-29). The tracked cases are European, with China and India.

THE COUNT MADE THE HOLDINGS. 'Over 40 U.S. claims' is the page's summary sentence, 'There are now over 40 copyright claims being litigated in the US'; no US case is in the tracker's list. The record's '23 cases in 10 jurisdictions (no US cases listed)' stands, and now quotes the sentence. Checked 2026-10-29 against the MMRS meta-aggregator record of 2026-10-28 and the entity's own pages, re-read the same day.
THE CASES RIGHT. Getty v. Stability AI, Kneschke v. LAION and ANI v. OpenAI are in CMS's pages, the last with its interim order of 24 July 2026 (the India card).
A NEIGHBOUR. Taylor Wessing's AI and Copyright Case Tracker (Carlsen, Penguin, GEMA v. OpenAI and Suno, Koda, SNE v. Meta) is another aggregator; added as a candidate.
